accepted_gaps.because: Sole operator on this repository: the one account that merges cannot approve its own pull request, so a required approval count of 1 would block every merge. Protection (restored 2026-09-24 and confirmed intended by the operator) requires a pull request, strict `lint`, `unittest` and `body-lint`, and enforce_admins; the approval count stays 0. What stands in for a human approval is the review lane: `sd-ship prepare` requires an independent local review from a different vendor than the author, and `sd-ship merge` refuses unacknowledged pull-request review findings.
accepted_gaps.until: a second account with push or merge rights on this repository exists
